newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's agricultural imports rise Jan to Aug.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's agricultural imports rise Jan to Aug.

text.p: South Korea's agricultural product imports from January to August rose 19.9 percent to $4.48 billion from $3.74 a year ago, the agriculture ministry said in a statement on Monday.
Livestock product imports gained 3.0 percent to $855.3 million from $830 million a year ealier.
The rise was mainly due to higher prices on the international market, the statement said.

In volume terms, corn imports for the period rose 2.9 percent to 6.02 million tonnes from 5.85 million tonnes a year ago and wheat imports rose 18.2 percent to 1.88 million tonnes from 1.59 million tonnes, while soybean imports fell 1.2 percent to 901,000 tonnes from 912,000 tonnes.
Beef imports fell 3.3 percent to 119,000 tonnes from 123,000 tonnes a year ago and pork imports fell 7.9 percent to 35,000 tonnes from 38,000 tonnes.
